rows.col_1: POST https://developer.api.autodesk.com/bim360/assets/v1/projects/{projectId}/categories/{categoryId}/relationships
user context required
data:write data:create
JSON
Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is obtained via a three-legged OAuth flow.
Must be application/json
The BIM 360 project ID. Must be a UUID or a project ID of the form “b.{UUID}”.
The category ID
An array of entities in other domains to link to the specified category.
The ID of the related entity.

The entity type of the entity to link.
Within BIM 360 projects, the only allowable type is checklisttemplate.
Specifying any other entity types will return a 400 status code.
Possible values: checklisttemplate, formtemplate

(Internal use only.) An externally-generated unique UUID for the new relationship. Should not be supplied,
in which case the Relationship service will generate the ID and it will be returned by this endpoint.

The relationship ID, a GUID that uniquely identifies the relationship.
The date and time that the relationship was created.
